project_name: Vía Segura - Plataforma de Monitoreo de Seguridad Vial en Peajes
target_audience: Operadores de infraestructura vial, gestores de peajes y analistas de seguridad vial en Colombia

design_philosophy.theme: Dark Mission Control with Premium Glassmorphism & Kinetic Typography
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Authority, vigilance, precision, high technology, and life-saving trust
core_principles: Tactical Clarity: Zero ambiguity in high-stakes road safety telemetry
High-Contrast Glassmorphism: Layered slate and indigo surfaces with subtle glowing borders
Bidirectional Interactivity: Instant visual correlation between maps, tables, and telemetry cards
Kinetic Motion & Awwwards Craft: Line-masked text reveals, slow editorial marquees, and tactical radar scan pulses
Localized Precision: Strict adherence to Colombian formatting (COP $, DD/MM/YYYY, HH:MM 24h, Ruta Nacional codes)

hierarchy.h1_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-50

layout_and_grid.viewport_target: Desktop-first 1440x900px, fully responsive down to mobile

central_interactive_map.type: Mapa Estilizado Táctico Oscuro con radar scan effect
central_interactive_map.segment_card: Tarjeta de Categorización Vial con velocidad máxima, pendiente, índice de riesgo y volumen de tráfico

vista_accidentes_siniestros.layout: Interactive split view (Tactical Map + Master Data Table)
vista_accidentes_siniestros.interactivity: Bidirectional sync: clicking a table row zooms & highlights map marker; clicking map marker selects table row with glowing aura

centro_de_alertas.realtime_features: Live alert feed simulation with sound toggle, severity filters, countdown timers, and team assignment modal

effects: Hero text reveal: Line-by-line masked stagger animation
Editorial Ribbon Marquee: Slow continuous horizontal scroll for operational status ticker
Radar Scan Pulse: CSS conic-gradient rotation over map canvas for radar surveillance effect
Card Entrance: Staggered fade-in-up with spring physics (damping: 25, stiffness: 200)
Hover Elevate: Subtle 3D tilt or -4px Y translate with glowing border pulse

data_testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive and telemetry element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the complete prototype with mock data for Colombia toll roads (e.g. Autopista Norte, Bogotá-Girardot, Peaje Chusacá, Peaje Andes).
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor icons for telemetry, status indicators, and tactical icons.
Ensure glassmorphism backdrop blurs do NOT collapse on webkit or lower opacity states.
Use Sonner for operational toast notifications (e.g. 'Nueva alerta crítica registrada en Km 34').
Make the map component highly interactive with custom styled dark SVG canvas or Leaflet markers.
All text content MUST be in Colombian Spanish as specified in the prompt.
